implementation.compact_hot_checkpoint: Rotation stores the exact current event rows once in the active checkpoint, one exact tip manifest, O(manifest-history) semantic/hash/batch/clock/input identity facts, current membership and pending-future state, and the predecessor HEAD. It removes cumulative manifests from the active checkpoint but does not claim constant total store size.
implementation.exact_archival_lineage: Exact legacy replay iteratively follows predecessor HEADs to one full checkpoint, preserves physical event order and every manifest, and cross-checks each compact capsule against the reconstructed archival base. Old objects remain immutable and lineage-reachable; successful rotation never deletes them.
implementation.hot_state_and_writer: Current state load and fresh append read only the active checkpoint plus current-generation tail. Historical, checkpoint-head, and tail retries use the active identity capsule and reconstructed predecessor registries to preserve legacy duplicate/conflict, clock, input, event, manifest, batch, and error-order semantics without archive traversal.
implementation.rotation_publication: Rotation shares HEAD.json.lock with append, validates exact pre-state, create-only publishes and re-reads the deterministic compact checkpoint, verifies logical counts/tip/boundaries, and atomically switches HEAD last after predecessor-byte recheck. Concurrent rotations commit once; pre-HEAD failures leave only unreachable orphans, and post-commit uncertainty retries return already_compact.
implementation.audit_and_containment: Audit holds the shared lock across hot/exact snapshots and enumeration, separates superseded from true orphan objects, and never adopts or deletes. Storage directory links/junctions/non-directories, referenced record links, immutable collision links/special files, and lock links/multiple hard links fail closed before external reads or writes.
implementation.honest_ceiling: Exact replay, rotation, and audit remain low-frequency cold paths whose cost follows immutable archival volume. The new reader can read prior full-v1 stores, but an old binary cannot forward-read the new compact record type under the same umbrella v1 contract. Runtime wiring, rollback/capability strategy, market-scale cadence, external append anchor, canonical evidence, and production authority remain unclaimed.

This reduces the chance that partial, rolled, duplicated, or escaped storage is mistaken for a valid research history; it creates no alpha, outcome evidence, validation result, or canonical PIT upgrade.
